actions.name: 주소 → 좌표 (지오코딩)
actions.description: Turn a Korean address or place name into latitude and longitude. `addresses` takes up to 30 in ONE call — use it instead of N single calls when placing several points on a map. This is the step that gives every route and static-map action its coordinates.

actions.name: 좌표 → 주소 (역지오코딩)
actions.description: Turn latitude and longitude back into a road-name and lot-number address. Use it to label a point the user picked or a coordinate a tool returned.

actions.name: 주소 검색 (부분 일치)
actions.description: Search addresses by fragment when the full address is unknown. Returns candidates with coordinates. Page size caps at 30 here — the 45 you may remember is the PAGE cap, not the size cap, and asking for more returns a 400.

actions.name: 장소 키워드 검색 (맛집·카페·역 등)
actions.description: Find places by what they are called — '강남역 카페', '판교 음식점'. Optionally bounded to a circle with lat_center/lon_center/radius, or filtered to one category group. `keywords` takes up to 30 in ONE call. Page size caps at 15 here; a larger limit returns a 400.

actions.name: 카테고리로 주변 검색 (편의점·주차장·병원 등)
actions.description: List every place of one category near a point or inside a rectangle — the way to answer '이 근처 편의점 다 찾아줘' without naming any of them. The category code is required here, unlike in keyword search.

params.sort: accuracy(기본) 또는 distance. distance 는 중심 좌표가 있어야 함

actions.name: 좌표 → 행정구역 (시도·시군구·읍면동)
actions.description: Which administrative region a coordinate falls in, both the legal-dong and the administrative-dong answer. Use it to group points by district, or to get the 시군구 a tool needs.

actions.name: 좌표계 변환 (WGS84 ↔ TM/WTM/KTM 등)
actions.description: Convert one coordinate pair between coordinate systems. Note that x and y are NOT always longitude and latitude — TM and WTM are metres. Needed when another source hands you non-WGS84 coordinates.

actions.name: 대중교통 길찾기 (버스·지하철·환승)
actions.description: Public-transport directions between two coordinates — total time, fare, and the bus/subway legs with their transfers. Separate from the walk and bicycle actions because transit takes NO waypoints and no route preference. `path.points` come back as [경도, 위도], which is the order a map Polyline wants.

params.includePath: 경로 선 좌표 포함 여부 — 지도에 그릴 때만 true (응답 대부분이 이 좌표들)

actions.name: 도보 길찾기
actions.description: Walking directions, with up to five waypoints and a route preference (BROAD_FIRST default, SHORTEST, ACCESSIBLE). Those two options are why walking is its own action — transit routing accepts neither.

actions.name: 자전거 길찾기
actions.description: Bicycle directions, with waypoints and its own set of route preferences. Kept apart from walking because the preference values differ.

actions.name: 정적 지도 이미지 (PNG)
actions.description: Render a map as a PNG and land it in the media store, so a map can go into a document, a report or a message. Markers place themselves and set the centre and zoom when supplied. The image is a picture: it cannot be panned or zoomed — an on-screen map the reader can move is the `map` render component instead.

params.logoPos: 카카오 로고 위치 — 이미지에 새겨져 제거 불가, 이동만 가능
params.name: 저장 파일 이름
